name: node-worker
title: Node background worker
description: A standalone TypeScript worker: BullMQ consumers, Prisma against the same database as your API, pino logging, and PM2 + Docker for deployment. For jobs that should not share a process with the HTTP server — scrapers, schedulers, long-running imports.

prisma.title: Prisma database access
prisma.description: Shares the schema with your API, so the worker reads and writes the same models rather than going through HTTP.

queue.title: BullMQ consumers
queue.description: Worker processes pulling from the same Redis queues your API produces to.

browser.title: Headless browser (Puppeteer)
browser.description: For scraping pages that need JavaScript executed. Heavy — the Docker image grows by roughly 300 MB.

pm2.title: PM2 process manager
pm2.description: ecosystem.config.cjs for running the worker under PM2 outside Docker.

hooks.title: format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the node-worker template'

nextSteps: Bring in the API's Prisma models: copy its prisma/schema/*.prisma beside prisma/schema/base.prisma, or share one schema via a submodule.
Edit .env — DATABASE_URL and REDIS_* must match the API's.
